pages.title: Planck Casing
pages.text: Armour for working at the smallest length that means anything. Neutronium plate gives it unyielding density, Planck shards set its grain to the scale of quantum gravity, and a spacetime casing core keeps the inside from bubbling away into foam.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)My first harvester rig dissolved into fizz at the Planck scale. Bonding Planck shards onto neutronium over a spacetime casing produced walls fine-grained enough that the foam could not slip between them.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Thermodynamics of Information.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.
